# E0422: a when names a field that is not a condition

A when names a field bare, which tests a field's presence when the field is
optional; a field that is always present is not a condition. Compare it with
something to make one.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
	count: int
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	tip: {
		name:  v0_0.name
		count: _drop(v0_0.count)
	}
	lacunas: {
		count: [{
			type:    DroppedField
			message: "count is gone"
			when:    v0_0.name
		}]
	}
}

BackwardLens: {
	tip: _
	v0_0: {
		name:  tip.name
		count: 0
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0418]: _drop is not defined in a lens; an expression refers to v0_0, to len, quo, rem, div, mod and to the strings functions
 --> tip.thema:9:10
  |
9 |         count: _drop(v0_0.count)
  |                ^^^^^
  |

error[E0422]: v0_0.name is string, not a condition
  --> tip.thema:15:13

   |                      ^^^^

   = help: compare v0_0.name to a value, or name an optional field bare to test whether it is present

5 | ForwardLens: {
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^

  = help: write <field>: v0_0.count to move it, or count: _drop
```
